plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Radiologic Technology, BAS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/radiologic-technology-bas/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid, hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Admission requires an active ARRT or equivalent registry and an Associate Degree in Radiologic Technology from a regionally accredited program. The published schedule's 2nd-5th semesters each carry unnamed blank blocks — the catalog does not name courses for these rows; they are modeled as transfer-block choice slots with an honest note. The program can be completed in 12 months with courses in 8-week blocks. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
